headline: Financing support for exporters: BSMV exemption on rediscount loans expanded | Economy
summary: A new regulation published in the Official Gazette extends the BSMV exemption to commercial bank rediscount loans sourced from the central bank. Long-term loans are also included in its scope.
why: The Banking and Insurance Transaction Tax (BSMV) adds to loan costs, so exemptions change financing costs for exporters.
